assets.packs.description: List the asset packs in every store, the selected pack and where that choice came from. Host side, no Kit, no USD parser. Writes nothing. Kit reads its own settings: give host and Kit the same ISAAC_MCP_ASSET_PATH, or Kit will not see these packs. With a Kit connected it also lists kit_environment and warns when Kit and this host use different project files, stores or strict mode.

assets.pack_doctor.description: Check a pack without changing it: corrupt, missing and unpinned files, then the dependencies of its entry files (unresolved, unreadable, remote, outside the pack). A file accepted at build time with allow_unresolved is still missing, so it is reported and ok is false until the file is added: assets__import_path refuses it for the same reason. Unused files are information. Parses USD in a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; says so if neither ran, and ok is then false. A URDF's own references are read on the host.

pack.description: Pack name. Default: the selected pack.

entries.description: Files in the pack that are its roots. Default: recorded in the pack, or the twin's known names for ur5e-dt.

assets.dependencies.description: Compute dependency closures for files under an approved root or a user asset store. USD uses UsdUtils.ComputeAllDependencies through a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. A .urdf is read on the host with the build's package rules and returns its meshes, textures and package.xml, so a missing package is reported instead of a parser error. Copies nothing.

assets.pack_adopt.description: Create a pack in the primary asset folder, or copy a folder's asset files into it and pin them. The source must be under a user-approved root; no tool can approve folders. A symlink is never followed: a named one is refused, and one met while copying a folder is listed in skipped_symlinks with a note. A different file already there is refused unless force=true; nothing is written inside the repository.

dry_run.description: Report the plan and write nothing.

force.description: Replace files that differ from the source.

assets.pack_build.description: Copy USD or URDF files and only what they depend on into a pack in the primary asset folder, keeping relative layout, and pin them. A URDF brings its meshes, their textures and any package.xml it needs. Sources must be under an approved root or a user asset store; nothing outside is copied. Unresolved or remote references refuse the build unless allow_unresolved=true, which records them; such a pack still will not import until the files are added, so the result says importable=false with import_blockers. Files that differ need force=true. Checks the new pack afterwards.

origin.description: Where these files came from, one line (for example a repository URL and commit). Recorded in the pack's isaac-mcp-pack.json and listed by assets__packs, so you can see later what a pack used.

allow_unresolved.description: Build despite missing or remote references, and record them.

assets.import_urdf.description: Convert a URDF with the installed importer and import it, from an approved root or a pack in your asset folder. Resolves package:// meshes inside that folder only and reports what it mapped. Gives joints with no gains drives that hold a pose, lifts a robot out of a ground plane, and warns about unusable mass or inertia. Source files never change. Z up, metres. Refuses xacro, DTDs, URLs, paths leaving the folder and missing meshes. Check a URDF first with assets__dependencies. Returns authored values, not runtime readiness. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

session_id.description: Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).

stage_id.description: Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.

root_id.description: Approved root ID, with relative_path. Or use source_path.

relative_path.description: Path of the .urdf file within that root.

source_path.description: Absolute path of the .urdf file, under an approved root or in a pack of your asset folder (pins are checked). Replaces root_id and relative_path.

fixed_base.description: Fix the robot's base to the world. Pass false for a robot that drives or walks; it then falls under gravity.

default_drives.description: Author position drives that hold a pose; the URDF format has none. A stiffness in a 6.x conversion is kept, and the 5.x importer's own is replaced. With false you get the importer's own: on 6.x stiffness 0, so targets do nothing until sim__joints__drive sets gains.

position.description: Three finite coordinates in stage units. Omit to place the robot at the origin, raised out of any collision ground plane. A given position is used as is, with a warning if it starts under the ground.

assets.import_mjcf.description: Convert a MuJoCo MJCF model (.xml) with the installed importer and import it, from an approved root or a pack in your asset folder. Follows <include> files, meshes, textures and height fields inside that folder only, and refuses absolute paths, URLs and anything that leaves it. A model with a free joint floats and falls; fixed_base left out keeps what the file says. Source files never change. Z up, metres. Returns authored values, not runtime readiness. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.
